name: Sabse Pehle Isko Samapt Karenge
visual_description: Akhilendra Mishra portraying Ravana in mythological TV series Ramayan with wide furious eyes and a grand crown, accompanied by the subtitle 'Sabse pehle isko samapt karenge!'.
usage_context: Used to express an eager determination to finish or eliminate an easy task, target, or annoyance first before tackling anything else.

example.top_text: Me spotting the 2-mark question in a 3-hour exam:

text_areas.description: Setup scenario or trigger for wanting to finish off something first
